designNotes: Paired scans complete a session; no-booking scans are errors; two PTs need two pairs. The reasons for a missing side are the open question

cases.title: Paired scans of the customer and the right PT within 15 minutes complete the session

steps.action: POST the customer scan for a booked session, then the PT scan 10 minutes later
steps.expected: The session turns to Đã tập

steps.action: Open the contract and the PT credits
steps.expected: Sessions left fell by 1; the PT has 1 credit for it
Exactly one email for the session

cases.title: A scan with no booking is an error

steps.action: POST a customer scan when the customer has no booking today
steps.expected: Refused with an error; no session is created or changed

cases.title: A customer training with two PTs needs a pair for each

steps.action: Book two sessions today with two PTs; POST the customer scan and the first PT scan
steps.expected: Only the first session turns to Đã tập

steps.action: POST the second PT scan with a second customer scan
steps.expected: The second session turns to Đã tập

testConditions: two PTs, one or two pairs
